Chapter 6891: New Authority

Chapter 6891: New Authority

“And you all?” Guangmai asked the members of Dark Realm.

The three messengers exchanged a complicated glance. In terms of relationship, they had deeper ties with Guangmai since they have been around since Mang’s generation.

Immortal Emperor Gu Chun arrived much later. Nevertheless, he did entrust them with full authority.

“We agree.” Nevertheless, they still accepted since at this point, their stance mattered not.

They could have prevented this before Guangmai’s appearance. Unfortunately, the primordial immortal was too strong, not to mention everyone else’s opinion.

The opposing side had all the advantages in Immortal Emperor Gu Chun’s absence. Further resistance meant the end of Dark Realm. Guangmai was only asking them for show.

“Agree.” The Linked-Pentastars didn’t wish to die needlessly either.

“It is settled. Immortal Emperor Gu Chun is henceforth removed from his position. Hand the authority over.” Fire Immortal said.

“Do it.” Controller sighed and told the five old men.

“Authority.” They summoned massive Dark Desire laws, looking like dragons.

“The devouring way.” The three messengers summoned their laws as well.

The laws coiled together and formed a divine lotus, large enough to make planets look like dust specks.

“Authority, initiate.” The trio’s words echoed across Stygian.

Dark Realm’s members accepted the command and activated the grand momentum.

“Boom!” An eternal light surged out of a black portal in Dark Realm.

This titanic light could assault the dao heart of a golden immortal and make them fall to the darkness. It was thick enough to become liquid.

Those in Golden Lamp took note of this and felt despair. Just one drop of this ocean could extinguish them.

Within the ocean were Dark Desire laws, seemingly locking and borrowing its power. They stretched from the center to the outer limits.

“Release.” The three messengers’ laws flew into the ocean’s center and pulled with all of their might.

Meanwhile, everyone watched with bated breath. The authority of the alliance was a tangible entity, not just an abstract concept.

It represented the alliance’s power and legitimacy. Controlling this authority required being accepted by this ocean. They could then use the ultimate move of the alliance - High Heaven Obliteration.

“Boom!” The messengers pulled a dark staff out of the ocean. Overlords dropped to the ground while immortals lowered their head.

This staff, the embodiment of the so-called authority, was wrapped around by Dark Desire laws. In other words, Dark Desire originated from this staff.

“Dark Desire is no more.” Guangmai announced and raised one hand.

His hand became massive and pulsed brilliantly as he reached for the staff.

“We agree.” The alliance agreed unanimously and released their dark power.
